title: Longest Palindrome
summary: Determine the length of the longest palindrome that can be constructed using the characters of a given string, where character case is significant.
statement: Determine the length of the longest palindrome that can be constructed using the characters of a given string, where character case is significant.
constraints: 1 <= len(s) <= 2000; uppercase and lowercase are distinct.
Characters may be reordered; return the greatest possible palindrome length.
hints: Every mirrored pair consumes two equal characters.
Take the largest even portion of each frequency.
After counting all pairs, add one center if any odd count exists.
All pairs can coexist symmetrically, while at most one unpaired character can occupy the center.
editorial: All pairs can coexist symmetrically, while at most one unpaired character can occupy the center.

tests.explanation: Three character pairs plus one center create a palindrome of length seven.
Case-sensitive characters differ, so only one can be used.
